Engineering the Arizona Standard

Arizona House of Film is a factory-certified installer of Smart Glass Technologies window films. In our desert climate, where surface temperatures can exceed 160°F, we choose Smart Glass Technologies for its industry-leading thermal stability and molecular-level UV inhibitors.

Whether you are targeting massive HVAC savings or protecting high-end interiors from solar degradation, Smart Glass Technologies provides the nanotechnology required for long-term performance in Phoenix and Scottsdale.

Arizona Climate Application

Smart Glass Technologies safety films are specified for applications combining security performance with solar control — particularly for Arizona retail and medical facilities where both theft deterrence and energy efficiency are required in a single product.
